steps.s1.title: Report to me straight away
steps.s1.body: As soon as an insured event happens, call or send a WhatsApp message. The sooner you report, the more precise and shorter the handling. I'm available in the evenings and for urgent cases too.
steps.s2.title: Document the event
steps.s2.body: Take photos, gather documents and write down the details — date, time, place, witnesses, phone numbers. Accurate documentation at the time is the basis of a smooth claim.
steps.s3.title: Go to the right authority
steps.s3.body: For a medical event — see a doctor or go to hospital and keep the documents. For a crime or an accident — file a police report. For damage to property — don't touch the scene before it is documented.
steps.s4.title: I file the claim
steps.s4.body: From this point I take over managing the claim — completing forms, submitting documents to the company and following it closely until the full cover is received. In most cases you won't have to make a single phone call.
types.t1.title: Supplementary health insurance
types.t1.p1: Keep medical documents: referrals, reports, hospitalisation, invoices and receipts
types.t1.p2: Report any treatment or surgery before the referral, if possible
types.t1.p3: For expensive medicines — attach the prescription and the doctor's confirmation
types.t2.title: Life insurance / death
types.t2.p1: Let me know straight away — I coordinate filing the claim with the company
types.t2.p2: Prepare the death certificate and the inheritance order or probate of the will
types.t2.p3: For loss of working capacity — a sick note from the treating doctor and the employer's confirmation
types.t3.title: Loss of working capacity
types.t3.p1: Report as soon as you stop working
types.t3.p2: Submit a sick note, the employer's confirmation and proof of income
types.t3.p3: Keep your treatment continuous — gaps in the records can delay payment
types.t4.title: Property / home / car
types.t4.p1: Photograph the damage from every angle before any repair
types.t4.p2: Don't touch the damaged area until it is fully documented and the assessor has approved
types.t4.p3: For a burglary or an accident — file a police report and keep the number

seo.title: Insurance claims support — what to do when something happens | Dorit Gov Ari
seo.description: A practical guide to filing an insurance claim: what to document, which documents you need, and how to deal with the insurance company. Personal support throughout.
seo.serviceType: Support with filing claims with insurance companies
hero.whatsappText: Hello Dorit, I'm reporting an insured event and need help with a claim.
hero.intro: An insured event can be stressful — but you're not alone. From the moment you report it, I take over managing the claim, until the full cover is received. Here are the clear steps that make for quick and accurate handling.
steps.title: Four steps to cover
types.title: Guidance by type of event
types.intro: Each type of claim needs different documentation. Choose the relevant category and follow the guidance — and at every stage, I'm here to support and help.
docs.intro: A general list of documents that speed up a claim. Not every document is relevant to every case — I'll agree the exact documents needed with you personally.
docs.keep: Keep your documents in one place, tidy and to hand
report.title: Report an insured event
report.intro: Fill in the basic details and attach the relevant documents. The report goes straight to Dorit, and she gets back to you personally to take the claim forward.
close.title: You're not alone when it counts
close.text: Thirty years of supporting claims have taught me one thing: clients shouldn't have to face the insurance companies alone. Report to me, and from there I lead — until the full cover is received.
